title: Structured Approval Gate — Output Contract (v1)
description: User decision captured at an approval gate. Emitted by the orchestrator after the user responds. Stored in the manifest and audit trail.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the decision was recorded

user_note.description: Optional free-text note from the user explaining the decision or requested changes

requested_changes.description: List of specific changes requested when decision is 'request_changes'

commit_triggered.description: Whether a git commit was triggered after this approval (only true for approve decisions at command boundary)

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA if commit_triggered is true

audit_entries.description: Audit bullets generated from this decision
